text:
dena: quick follow-up from the postmortem: we've seen a repeat pattern where DNS propagation delays + LB sticky remaps cause a short burst of 5xx and TLS retries for cross-region traffic (eu -> na). linking root postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2201234000. opening this thread to lock owners, timelines, and acceptance criteria.

ravi: confirmed. majority of failures align with registrar update spikes and immediate route-table changes. LB then reassigns cookies to older pools before the new route-version lands. last night we saw ~30s windows of elevated 502s.

karen: did TLS resume look like the driver or just collateral? I/O saw several handshake timeouts but they look correlated to mid-handshake disconnects when route changed.

miles: agreed, TLS was collateral. fixing the routing/timing should reduce retries. we should still add session-resume metrics so we can detect regressions.

ops-bot: Incident 2201234000 linked: route-propagation-dns-splay. Severity: P2. Tickets: INC-9702, TKT-2488.

dena: proposed remediation items (draft):
- implement registrar update smoothing (owner: ravi)
- add deploy pre-warm check for route propagation (owner: karen)
- LB sticky-fallback guard that verifies route-version before reassignment (owner: miles)
- add session-resume and route-mismatch metrics + alerts (owner: dena)
- runbook update + customer blurb (owner: liaison-cs)

ravi: vendor ticket created VND-4710. vendor suggests a staged-update API; testing in sandbox tomorrow. target PR for smoothing by 2026-04-07.

karen: pre-warm gate plan: webhook queries edge /route-status for expected route-version during canary. fail if mismatch ratio > 1%. target PR 2026-04-02, gate enabled on canary 2026-04-03.

miles: LB guard: prototype by 2026-04-09; canary 10% traffic for 2h. acceptance: no sticky-fallback events and no increase in 5xx for 2h. auto-rollback if canary fails.

dena: metrics & alerts: I'll add Prometheus rules and console alert. Proposed PromQL for route-mismatch ratio:

```
sum(rate(edge_route_mismatch_total[5m])) / sum(rate(edge_requests_total[5m]))
```

and session-resume fail rate:

```
sum(rate(tls_session_resume_failures_total[5m])) by (region)
```

ops-bot: Reminder: include ticket numbers in PRs so postmortem links automatically update.

liaison-cs: customer comms: drafting a short blurb for top impacted customers. will propose wording: acknowledgement + mitigation steps + ETA for canary. target message ready by 2026-03-31.

ravi: acceptance criteria draft:
- registrar smoothing: registrar_error_rate < 0.01% for 24h after deploy OR vendor confirms staged API reduces bursts
- pre-warm gate: deploy blocked if route_mismatch_ratio > 1% during canary check
- LB guard: 0 sticky-fallback events in 2h canary, no 5xx increase > baseline + 0.2%
- metrics: alert fires if session_resume_fail_rate > 0.5% for 15m (P3) and escalates to P2 if >1% for 15m
- runbook: PR merged and ops-runbook tag created

karen: smoke test checklist to include in PRs:
- run synthetic route-version check 20x from eu-west -> expect X-RW-Route-Version == v68
- verify `sum(rate(edge_route_mismatch_total[5m]))` < 5 over 15m
- sandbox registrar burst test: registrar_update_errors_total < 0.01%
- TLS resume smoke: `openssl s_client -connect edge-proxy:443 -servername api.redwood.example -sess_out s.bin` then reconnect with `-sess_in s.bin` to validate resume

miles: rollback plan: revert lb-configmap, restore sticky-cookie TTL, drain canary nodes. I'll add exact kubectl commands in PR.

dena: timeline recap + owners:
- ravi: registrar smoothing + vendor sandbox test -> PR by 2026-04-07, verify 24h sandbox
- karen: deploy pre-warm gate PR -> 2026-04-02, enable canary gate 2026-04-03
- miles: LB guard PR -> 2026-04-09, canary 2026-04-10
- dena: metrics + alerts -> 2026-03-31
- liaison-cs: runbook + customer blurb -> 2026-03-31

ops-bot: Calendar: follow-up check-in scheduled 2026-04-04 14:00 UTC to review PRs + canary readiness.

liaison-cs: acked. I'll post draft blurb to #customer-updates for review once ready.

ravi: vendor sandbox tests start tomorrow, will attach VND-4710 updates to INC-9702.

karen: opening deploy gate PR today and will add the webhook tests.

miles: ack, will post LB guard PR and rollback steps.

dena: thanks all. I'll update the postmortem actions page with these owners/dates and move items to "in progress". Reopen this thread if any blocker appears. :white_check_mark:
